basics.headline: Senior Software Engineer (Backend, AI Systems, Tech Lead)
basics.name: Stevan Pavlović
basics.workRights: Serbian citizen, currently in Vienna. Open to B2B contracts or EU visa sponsorship.

contributions.description: Since September 2025, lead a team of five that builds AI voice agents, workflow automation and fleet optimization for trucking companies, built mostly with Claude, using harness and context engineering.
Set the architecture of the fleet safety platform on Node.js, NestJS and Redis: pre-trip inspections, accident and damage reports, driver scorecards and live operational visibility.
Built real-time ingestion of vehicle and driver events with Redis pub/sub, from the mobile driver apps to the live operations dashboards.
Built scheduling, reminder and document modules that let fleet managers track regulatory renewals, inspections and maintenance compliance.

Led the architecture of the FundedBettor betting project and a multi-tenant casino project. Built 167Pluto's first event-driven system: NestJS and Kafka services for the bet lifecycle, odds and settlement, with tuned Kafka topics and streaming.
Made the settlement pipeline replay-safe with explicit idempotency keys.

Added staged rollouts and automated canary analysis for zero-downtime deployments through peak sporting events, plus tracing, structured logs and latency dashboards for faster incident diagnosis during live events.
Protected hot shards and kept reads fast at peak traffic.

Contributed to the backend-for-frontend layer of Humanity.com, a workforce management platform with hundreds of thousands of users, in Node.js and NestJS: one endpoint replaced 3 to 5 upstream API calls.
Owned the caching: Redis cache-aside with TTL invalidation and Redis tuning, plus circuit breakers that serve cached or partial data when upstreams slow down.
Decoupled frontend and backend releases through stable, versioned OpenAPI contracts.
Built automated video transcoding pipelines on AWS for a healthcare education platform, with idempotent retries, traceable state transitions and audit logging.
Split orchestration from media workers, and wrote AWS infrastructure as code.

Maintained the Symfony 4 core-banking monolith and architected Syllo, its NestJS microservice rewrite: bounded contexts, typed gRPC and Protobuf contracts, event-driven flows over Kafka and Redis, deployed on Kubernetes.
Added double-entry style balance checks and idempotent handlers on money-moving service boundaries.
Led a team of two engineers across backend and frontend, maintained the whole architecture, advised the DevOps engineer, and mentored the team in NestJS and event-driven design.
Worked for Catena Media on AskGamblers.com (150,000+ registered users): split legacy Symfony modules into cleaner service boundaries and cut resource use by up to 90% on high-load paths.
Removed PostgreSQL and Redis bottlenecks and tuned caching on SEO-critical public endpoints under hundreds of thousands of monthly visits.

Architected Intelligent Admissions, the Decision451 module of the Element451 higher-education CRM: rule-based scoring in PHP and Laravel over hundreds of properties per application, triggering enrollment workflows for 20+ partner institutions and hundreds of thousands of admissions.
Built PHP (Laravel, Symfony) and Node.js backends for agency clients, shared libraries for recurring patterns, and parts of the in-house deployment tooling.
Built a custom CMS in object-oriented PHP and JavaScript, and full-stack websites for clients in Serbia.
AI voice agents, workflow automation and fleet optimization for trucking fleets, built mostly with Claude.
NestJS services with gRPC, Protobuf, Kafka, Redis and Kubernetes.
One endpoint replaced 3 to 5 upstream calls, with Redis cache-aside and circuit breakers.
One public setup for three AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Opencode): 19 skills, 8 agents, and a Rust guard that enforces written rules on agent tool calls.
Personal site on Astro, React and three.js, with an MCP server on a Cloudflare Worker that gives AI agents 8 tools to read my profile, experience, skills and projects.

summary: Software engineer with 11 years in backend systems: Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, Kafka, PostgreSQL and Redis, across fintech, betting, healthtech and fleet logistics. Part-time CTO of Safety Real Time, where since September 2025 I lead a team of five that builds AI voice agents and workflow automation for trucking fleets. I work with AI coding agents every day, and I care about evals, correctness and clear interfaces.
